description: As eu07_td_hauls_dead_vectron, from a cold start: the trainset stands with velocity 0, so both locomotives start braked (brake pipe at 3.5 bar, batteries off, the Vectron's spring brake on). The EU07's driver gets the order to run as a train, starts the engine, charges the brake pipe and hauls the Vectron, prepared for hauling (parameter H), to Przystanek.
